title: Twilio Lists 22 A2P 10DLC Rejection Codes for December 9
desc: Twilio plans to introduce more specific A2P 10DLC campaign rejection codes on December 9, 2026. The 22 codes it lists, in three groups, and what to check now.
keywords: twilio a2p 10dlc rejection codes, a2p 10dlc campaign rejected, twilio error 30569, 10dlc campaign registration rejected, twilio a2p 10dlc error codes, a2p 10dlc opt-in proof
cta: Need texting and calling that pass review?
body:
November 14, 2026. Twilio's changelog entry dated November 13 says that, starting December 9, 2026, it plans to introduce more specific error codes for rejected US A2P 10DLC campaign registrations. The entry lists 22 codes in three groups: 5 about the campaign description, 10 about how people sign up, and 7 about the Privacy Policy and Terms and Conditions pages. Each code has a one-line meaning in the changelog.

What Twilio announced

The changelog entry says the codes "will provide more detailed feedback about campaign descriptions, opt-in methods, and Privacy Policy and Terms and Conditions pages". It also says the release "includes additional codes and the A2P 10DLC mapping for error 30569, which already exists in the Twilio error dictionary."

More specific codes are not new this year. Twilio's help article on rejected A2P 10DLC campaigns says: "From September 15, 2026, new shared error codes identify more specific rejection reasons for A2P 10DLC and Toll-Free Verification."

Campaign description: 5 codes

CodeWhat Twilio says it means
30977Campaign description doesn't name the business you registered
30984Description has unfilled template text
30985Marketing content in a campaign type that doesn't allow it
30986Campaign type doesn't match the texts in your description
30969Marketing campaign also describes texts that aren't marketing

How people sign up: 10 codes

Twilio calls this group "Message flow (how people sign up)". It is the largest of the three.

CodeWhat Twilio says it means
30965Sign-up proof doesn't open or can't be read
30966Consent was collected for affiliates or by another business
30978No link or screenshot of your text-to-join instructions
30979Verbal or phone opt-in script missing or incomplete
30980Website sign-up form has no phone number field
30982Paper sign-up form doesn't ask people to agree to get texts
30983Paper sign-up form wasn't provided
30987Sign-up consent doesn't match the texts this campaign sends
30988Chat widget named in Message flow isn't on your site
30569Call-to-Action is missing the message and data rates disclosure

Twilio's changelog says code 30569 already exists in its error dictionary. Its error page says it "applies to both Toll-Free Verification and A2P 10DLC registration", and that the call to action "does not disclose that message and data rates may apply to the messaging program."

Privacy Policy and Terms pages: 7 codes

CodeWhat Twilio says it means
30973Privacy Policy page didn't load
30974Privacy Policy page has too little text
30975Terms and Conditions page didn't load
30976Terms and Conditions page has too little text
30981Privacy Policy doesn't name the business you registered
30967Two Privacy Policy links open different policies
30968Two Terms and Conditions links open different terms

What Twilio says to do after a rejection

The changelog's instruction is short: "If your campaign is rejected, review every returned code and its linked guidance. Correct the identified issues, then follow the registration workflow available for your campaign. Resubmit an existing campaign only when it is eligible and the required changes are supported. Some corrections require a new campaign with the appropriate campaign type."

Two limits from Twilio's own pages are worth knowing before you plan a fix. Its troubleshooting guide says "Edits are available only for Campaigns with a FAILED status", and that the Console edit screen covers nearly all text fields "but NOT the use case itself". If the use case has to change, the guide says the campaign "would still need to be deleted and recreated." The help article adds: "A shared error code does not automatically make an A2P 10DLC campaign eligible for resubmission."

This is general information, not legal advice.

What we checked on November 14

The changelog links each of the 22 codes to a page in Twilio's error dictionary. When we opened all 22 on November 14, before the planned start date, 5 pages loaded (30569, 30973, 30974, 30975 and 30976) and 17 returned "Page not found". The help article on rejected campaigns did not mention December 9 yet. We did not check other Twilio pages.

Our read: using the list as a pre-submission checklist

You do not have to wait for December 9 to read the list. The grouping below is ours, not Twilio's, and a campaign that clears it can still be rejected. Here is what we would check before submitting or resubmitting a campaign, with the codes each check maps to:

  • The registered business name appears in the campaign description and in the Privacy Policy (30977, 30981).
  • The description has no leftover template text and matches the campaign type you picked (30984, 30985, 30986, 30969).
  • Every sign-up method you describe is backed by something a reviewer can open, and it is complete: the web form has a phone number field, the text-to-join instructions are linked or shown in a screenshot, the verbal script is complete, the paper form is provided and asks people to agree to get texts, and the chat widget is on your site (30965, 30978, 30979, 30980, 30982, 30983, 30988).
  • Consent was collected by your business, for the kind of texts this campaign sends (30966, 30987).
  • The call to action says message and data rates may apply (30569).
  • The Privacy Policy and Terms pages load, have enough text, and every link to them opens the same page (30973, 30974, 30975, 30976, 30967, 30968).

Related on our site: why A2P 10DLC campaigns get rejected, how the 10DLC daily message limit works and what 10DLC registration costs. If you also call the people you text, see how we set up AI calling built around TCPA consent.
faqs: When do Twilio's new A2P 10DLC rejection codes start?
Twilio's changelog entry of November 13, 2026 says it plans to introduce the more specific codes starting December 9, 2026. They apply to rejections of US A2P 10DLC campaign registrations.
How many A2P 10DLC rejection codes did Twilio list?

The changelog lists 22 codes: 5 about the campaign description, 10 about how people sign up, and 7 about the Privacy Policy and Terms and Conditions pages. The changelog says one of them, 30569, already exists in Twilio's error dictionary.
Can I resubmit a rejected A2P 10DLC campaign on Twilio?

Sometimes. Twilio says to resubmit an existing campaign only when it is eligible and the required changes are supported, and that some corrections require a new campaign. Its troubleshooting guide says edits are available only for campaigns with a FAILED status, and that the Console edit screen does not let you change the use case. In that case the guide says the campaign has to be deleted and recreated.
Twilio's error page titles it "Call-to-Action is missing the message and data rates disclosure". The page says the error applies to both Toll-Free Verification and A2P 10DLC registration.
